title: Talking About Salaries
sentences: In my first job I had no idea whether I was being paid fairly.
Discussing salaries was not forbidden, but it was clearly discouraged.
The silence was presented as a matter of good manners.
It took me some years to see whose interests that politeness served.
A colleague eventually told me what he earned, and the gap was substantial.
We had joined in the same month and did much the same work.
I asked for a raise and received part of what I had asked for.
The awkwardness of that conversation lasted about a week.
The difference in pay would have lasted for as long as I stayed.
I have told every younger colleague the same thing since then.
